step2_C_a_trace_map_side.structural_claim: The trace-map band-count ENTROPY equals log eps_a -- the SAME quantity as L_a, from the SAME object q_n. The period-q_n Sturmian approximant has q_n bands, and q_n ~ eps_a^n (the metallic recursion IS the CF-denominator recursion), so the band-count entropy per renormalization level is log eps_a. This is derived from the substitution combinatorics, NOT from any band-width numerics.
step2_C_a_trace_map_side.dimension_decomposition: By the entropy/contraction dimension formula, C_a = dim*ln lambda = (band-count entropy) / (per-level lambda-contraction exponent) = log eps_a / c_a, where c_a is the trace-map's large-lambda contraction exponent. So C_a's log-a coefficient is 1/c_infinity, and c_a is the ONLY trace-map-specific (non-shared) ingredient.

step3_plateau_prediction.claim: theta_inf = L_a / C_a = log eps_a / (log eps_a / c_a) = c_a. The shared log eps_a CANCELS. Because both L_a and C_a carry the same log eps_a growth, their ratio tends to a finite constant -- THIS is why the ladder plateaus, derived not fitted. The plateau value is c_infinity = lim_{a->inf} c_a, the trace-map's asymptotic large-lambda contraction exponent.

step3_plateau_prediction.numerology_guard: NO closed form is claimed for c_infinity. It is emphatically NOT asserted to be sqrt(2), even though the banked a=4,5 rungs straddle 1.414 -- that would be a guess reverse-justified, the exact trap this arc guards.
